verdict.rationale: The Request Changes Workflow (reviews.request_changes_workflow in .coderabbit.yaml) makes CodeRabbit post a blocking request-changes review whenever it leaves actionable inline comments, then approve once requirements are met. The docs show a GitHub PR blocked by this review, and the workflow is tied to resolved feedback and Pre-Merge Checks. missing for 10: an explicit required-status-check gating mode, severity-based gating that blocks only on critical findings (it keys on any actionable comment), documentation of the branch-protection setup needed to enforce it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
